data.name: Hur
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-r-r', meaning 'the light'. In Islamic tradition, Hur is a name given to angels and to certain spiritual beings. It is also a name of Allah, meaning 'the Light of the heavens and the earth'.

The idea of houri add an element of joy and divine reward to the concept of life after death.
